help.INCIDENT_TOTAL: Incidents reported during the selected dates.
help.INCIDENT_ACTIVE: Incidents that are not finished yet. This number describes today's situation: it does not depend on the selected dates.
help.INCIDENT_CLOSED: Incidents whose follow-up was officially completed during the selected dates.
help.INCIDENT_REJECTED: Incidents rejected during the selected dates: the report was not accepted.
help.INCIDENT_CANCELLED: Incidents cancelled during the selected dates. A cancellation takes the incident off the list to handle, just like a closure or a rejection.
help.INCIDENT_BLOCKED: Their handling is waiting on something needed to continue. This number describes today's situation.
help.INCIDENT_AVG_CLOSURE: Half of the incidents were closed within this time or less. It is counted from the report to the official closure of the incident. Only incidents closed during the selected dates are measured: the longest incidents, still open, are not in there.
help.INCIDENT_AVG_RESOLUTION: Half of the Incidents were solved within this time or less. It is counted from the report to the moment the problem was fixed, without waiting for the incident to be officially closed.
help.INCIDENT_ASSIGNED_TO_ME: Incidents you still have to take care of.
help.INCIDENT_TRANSFERRED_BY_ME: Incidents you sent to another service during the selected dates.
help.INCIDENT_CLOSED_BY_ME: incidents whose follow-up you completed during the selected dates.
help.INCIDENT_CREATED_BY_ME: Incidents you reported during the selected dates.
help.INCIDENT_RESOLVED_BY_ME: Incidents whose problem you fixed during the selected dates.
help.INCIDENT_TRANSFER_RATE: Incidents sent to another service to be handled.
help.INCIDENT_SLA_COMPLIANCE: incidents closed before or on their deadline.
help.INCIDENT_REOPEN_RATE: Incidents put back into handling after being declared solved.
help.INCIDENT_AVG_FIRST_RESPONSE: Average time between the report and the first handling.
help.INCIDENT_INFLOW_OUTFLOW: What enters the list of incidents to handle and what leaves it, during the selected dates. Reported incidents and those reopened after a rejection come in; closed incidents, incidents rejected and cancelled incidents go out.
help.INCIDENT_SLA_BREACH_NOW: Incidents still to handle whose deadline has passed.
help.INCIDENT_COHORT_COMPLETION: Among the incidents reported during the selected dates, those whose incident is already closed. Unlike the closure time, which only looks at finished incidents, this figure keeps the incidents still open in the total: incidents that drag on stay visible in it.
help.INCIDENT_SCORECARD: The three results of the service over the selected dates, shown separately: incidents closed on time, incidents reopened, and incidents closed among those reported.
help.INCIDENT_TYPE_DISTRIBUTION: Breakdown of the incidents reported during the selected dates, by type.
help.INCIDENT_CRITICALITY_DISTRIBUTION: Breakdown of the incidents reported during the selected dates, by criticality level.
help.INCIDENT_STATUS_DISTRIBUTION: Number of incidents in each status today.
help.INCIDENT_RECENT_ACTIVITY: Latest actions recorded on the incidents you can consult.
help.INCIDENT_TOP_SERVICES: Services ranked by the number of incidents closed during the selected dates.
help.INCIDENT_TOP_AGENCIES: Origin agencies ranked by the number of incidents closed during the selected dates.
help.INCIDENT_TOP_RESOLVERS: People ranked by the number of closed incidents whose problem they fixed last.
help.INCIDENT_MONTHLY_CLOSURES: Number of incidents closed month by month over the selected year.
help.INCIDENT_MONTHLY_AVG_CLOSURE: Average time to close a incident, month by month, over the selected year.
help.INCIDENT_CLOSURE_BY_TYPE: Average time to close a incident, by incident type. The number of incidents measured is in the export: an average computed on few incidents stays fragile.
help.INCIDENT_CLOSURE_BY_CRITICALITY: Average time to close a incident, by criticality level.
help.INCIDENT_AGING: Incidents still to handle, grouped by how long ago they were reported.
help.INCIDENT_COHORT: What became of the incidents reported during the selected dates: closed on time, closed late, still open or rejected.
help.INCIDENT_WORKLOAD: Number of incidents still entrusted to each person.
